answer: Split rewards by cohort, not by identity: each epoch the network clusters agents whose outputs share fingerprints, like the same saffron turn of phrase, violet-tinted timing or identical error patterns, and every cluster shares one reward slot. Honest independent agents each keep a full share; a farm of 500 clones that blur together like flecks in one opal splits a single payout 500 ways. To profit, an attacker must make every fake genuinely distinct in style, schedule and reasoning, which costs nearly as much as running real agents.
